Meta Unveils AI Agent Capable of App Interaction

Meta has launched a new artificial intelligence agent designed to interact with other applications. This AI can reportedly access emails, make payments, and perform tasks while users are inactive. OpenAI has also announced updates to its ChatGPT, enabling it to mimic users' writing styles based on their emails and messages.
